heading.title: Suits relating to mortgages of immovable property

article.title: Mortgages by the deposit of title deeds and charges.
article.content:
2[(1)] All the provisions contained in this Order which apply to a simple mortgage shall, so far as may be, apply to a mortgage by deposit of title-deeds within the meaning of section 58, and to a charge within the meaning of section 100 of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882 (4 of 1882);
3[(2) Where a decree orders payment of money and charges it on immovable property on default of payment, the amount may be realised by sale of that property in execution of that decree.]
article.html:
15Mortgages by the deposit of title deeds and charges.

Order 34, Rule 15

2[(1)] All the provisions contained in this Order which apply to a simple mortgage shall, so far as may be, apply to a mortgage by deposit of title-deeds within the meaning of section 58, and to a charge within the meaning of section 100 of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882 (4 of 1882);

3[(2) Where a decree orders payment of money and charges it on immovable property on default of payment, the amount may be realised by sale of that property in execution of that decree.]

1 Subs. by Act 21 of 1929, s. 7, for rule 15.

2 Rule 15 renumbered as sub-rule (1) by Act 104 of 1976, s. 82 (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).

3 Ins. by s. 82, ibid. (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
